description: Search across the Croatian Registry of True Owners (RSV) to discover all companies and legal entities associated with a specific individual owner or representative. RULES: Never invent personal identities, birth details, or corporate connections. If criteria are missing, interview the user first.

birth_month_year.description: Birth month and year in format MM.YYYY (e.g. 02.1974)

company_name.description: Optional partial match on company name

first_name.description: First name of the true owner or representative

last_name.description: Last name of the true owner or representative

name: search_true_owners
